title: Retire the old launch doors while preserving their routes and attribution

source.ref: Daniel-approved Gate A retirement plan, 2026-11-11; coordination claim on #4306 reserves LIVE-2262 for codex/gate-a-retired-doors.

detail:
The retired /go campaign doors, /free-spotlight landing, Vera /spaces/launch drafter, and /start/[flow] splash must stop rendering while their old links keep reaching the right survivor through permanent 308 redirects. Keep /start/host live for invite attribution. Next.js config redirects run before filesystem routes, use 308 when permanent:true, and carry incoming query parameters through, including UTM and gclid values (Next 16 redirecting and redirects config docs). Daniel explicitly approved re-aiming only LIVE-1969, LIVE-1629, and LIVE-2158 on 2026-11-11. Their probes now verify the permanent /go survivor map, the /free-spotlight to /create-a-space campaign redirect, and the /spaces/launch plus legacy /start redirects while retaining checks for surviving funnel layouts. No other probes were changed. The row probe and the three re-aimed probes pass locally. The source acceptance is complete on this branch after the row check and all three approved probes pass. Exact-head checks and preview behavior remain separate PR readiness gates, not proof of production serving. LIVE-962 is not a fourth probe blocker: the git ls-files check passes when staged deletions are represented in the branch index.

Daniel-approved retirement re-aims: LIVE-1969 now checks the retained wizard wiring and exact permanent /go redirects; LIVE-1629 keeps the button and switch checks and verifies the former landing redirects to the tagged wizard; LIVE-2158 preserves surviving funnel layout checks and verifies the retired launch and /start redirects. Only these three probes were re-aimed. Exact-head preview and production proof remain PR gates.

verify.note: The combined row probe covers retained Create a Space door wiring, exact permanent redirect survivors for retired routes, preservation of /start/host, and surviving funnel layouts. It does not claim preview or production verification.
